notes.title: STATUS: CURATED
notes.content:
Plenty of Steam curators have recommended STATUS: INSANE, yet none of them have unrecommended it. Which is a great success! 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30437390/1ffc1c9296dcb16af0ca74ff5b9773f74204165f.png[/img]

Here are some fine examples:

[h1]TechRaptor[/h1] 

"STATUS: INSANE a bit clunky around the edges, but it's also a fun puzzle game that occasionally wanders into brilliant territory" 

[h1]FSGGA[/h1] 

"This game was pure awesomeness! It had this thing which kept you wanting to return to this game all the time. I would say that this game is worth of every dollar!" 

[h1]Pro-G GamingCommunity[/h1] 

"A fun maze puzzle game. The game is very challenging, with many incredibly great levels. Soundtrack is amazing and makes the game more enjoyable. It's one of the best top-down view escaping games!"

[h1]Puzzled Adventurers[/h1] 

"Insanely strange and original puzzle adventure game. Great puzzles with new mechanics added at a steady pace to keep it fresh and a completely insane story."

[h1]_Gamerworld_[/h1] 

"This is a game from a finnish developer, where you play as Igor, a patient of some sort. The game is nothing but crazy, there are random notes and even finglish! I found this really fun to play! 8/10"

[h1]Kettu Gaming[/h1] 

"A very fun game where the objective is to escape a mental asylum. Combines puzzle and strategy elements and has collectible items for extra challenge. Highly recommended." 

Here is the full list of STATUS: INSANE curations: http://store.steampowered.com/curators/curatorsreviewing/?appid=654430


Thank you for your interest. Cheers! ːsteamhappyː

Yours Sincerely,
Team Frostbullet

notes.title: STATUS: SPEEDRUNNING HAS NEVER BEEN THIS MUCH OF.. FUN
notes.content:
One of STATUS: INSANE speedrunners named zment made a handy AutoSplitter script for LiveSplit. It automatically starts the timer, changes the splits and, finally, stops the timer. We made some modifications to the game as well so that using the splitter would be as easy as possible. Read more from here: https://steamcommunity.com/app/654430/discussions/0/1620599015872680279/

STATUS: INSANE speedrun community is also growing, and new world records are being made pretty much every day. You can find the official leaderboards from here: https://www.speedrun.com/STATUS_INSANE

Here are the best runs so far (updated 23th January 2018):

Any% Normal world record is held by zment: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=olams7Et07k
Any% Masochist world record is held by Serd: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=yTkzH8p5xAY
100% Normal world record is held by zment: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jM3sc2_CtCY&lc=z23vt1xxynqghltdgacdp433w2zhx22cmru4gq1ktetw03c010c.1514638976301934
100% Masochist world record is held by zment:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=uyQkp30rQjw
OYB% Normal world record is held by thonder_wavemastor: 
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=tlSpH7a7JAk
OYB% Masochist world record is held by thonder_wavemastor: 
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=tlSpH7a7JAk

Feel free to (try) beat them!

Some speedrunners have even done STATUS: INSANE live racing at SpeedRunsLive: http://www.speedrunslive.com/races/game/#!/statusinsane/1

Feel free to join the races!


Thank you for your interest. Cheers! ːsteamhappyː

Yours Sincerely,
Team Frostbullet

notes.title: STATUS: REVIEWED
notes.content:
Thank you guys for the awesome user reviews you’ve written about STATUS: INSANE. We are absolutely stunned by the positive feedback you’ve given us. 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30437390/1ffc1c9296dcb16af0ca74ff5b9773f74204165f.png[/img]

Here are some fine examples:

"I mean... there's clearly something wrong with whoever made this game, the cringe is very real at certain points, with dubious jokes and weird visuals but you know what? The game's actually good!"

"You can see that this game has been made with heart, soul, intelligence, and not to mention HUGE creativity :)"

"...great art got own distinguishable style with ballface guards and everything..."

"The music and voice overs are also on point, giving an extra feeling of darkness. Overall they help to achieve the feeling of being escaping of the mental asylum."

"The guy who made this obviously has some first hand experience on  mental illness."

"Truly magnificent puzzle game with interesting setting and awesome characters."

"Delightfully madcap, Status Insane is a glimpse at what a good indie game should look like."

"I really enjoyed this game! Def say buy it and have a good time"

"Insane graphics and gameplay!!"

"5/5, now I have seen it all."


Thank you for your interest. Cheers! ːsteamhappyː

Yours Sincerely,
Team Frostbullet

[i]STATUS: INSANE[/i] is [i]STATUS: READY[/i] and [i]STATUS: RELEASED[/i]!

[b]Thank you for your patience[/b]!!

In addition, there is this thing called [i]STATUS: INSANE Final Trailer[/i]… The trailer shows quite clearly that when you develop a game about escaping from a mental asylum for almost three (3) years, you might actually start looking like you have been developing a game about escaping from a mental asylum for almost three (3) years...

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=sJRsLAFtatk

Thank you for your interest. Cheers! ːsteamhappyː

Yours Sincerely,
Team [i]Frostbullet[/i]

notes.title: STATUS: HISTORY GRADUATE
notes.content:
Full-time development of STATUS: INSANE started at spring 2015. Our hero, Igor, used to look much more… boxy back in the days. ːsteammockingː

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30437390/5bfb3bcaa1c55636af062de825eea80282b39374.gif[/img]

STATUS: INSANE's very first graphical vision was to create something that 3D Hotline Miami would look like. Then we realized that it didn’t feel right (too much disco) so we reworked everything and made the game look darker and more atmospheric and such.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30437390/78d315da6ba028ba9f327bfc9287b91f11980cb1.gif[/img]     

Thank you for your interest. Cheers! ːsteamhappyː

Yours Sincerely,
Team Frostbullet
